instruction: Configure VS Code to trim trailing whitespace on save and insert a final newline at the end of files.

metadata.explanation: This task configures two VS Code file cleanup settings that are commonly used together: trimming whitespace and ensuring final newline. The evaluator uses check_json_settings to verify both configurations.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VS Code settings.json from the correct path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly handles expected parameter as rules dict and extracts nested 'expected' key
Complete coverage: Both required settings (files.trimTrailingWhitespace and files.insertFinalNewline) are verified
Expected values are semantically correct: both settings set to true match the instruction requirements
Data flow is correct: file getter -> JSON parsing -> key-value verification for both settings
No postconfig needed as settings.json is a persistent configuration file
Metric logic properly iterates through all expected key-value pairs and returns 0.0 if any mismatch

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
